summary: The candidate fixes the evidenced Qwen3-VL deepstack linear_fc LoRA path, but does not implement MOSS-VL-specific dimensions and introduces an unbounded deepstack namespace match.

tests.what_was_measured: Recorded base returned no layer id for a reported deepstack adapter tensor and raised NotImplementedError for linear_fc1/linear_fc2 hidden dimensions.
Candidate regression and adjacent hidden-dimension compatibility; 17 tests passed.
Qwen3-VL dimensions, normalization, row sharding, valid/malformed/unindexed layer parsing, and namespace false positives.
BF16 rank-32 projection arithmetic for 4608x4608 and 4608x4096 shapes against CPU FP32 references on gfx950.

gpu_execution.evidence: AMD Instinct MI350X, gfx950, ROCm 7.2; candidate GPU reference completed for both reported Qwen3-VL projection shapes.

remaining_counterexamples: MossVLForConditionalGeneration has no model-specific get_hidden_dim override; its concatenating merger has architecture-specific input dimensions not supplied by the Qwen3-VL-only candidate.
get_layer_id('model.notdeepstack_merger_list.4.linear_fc2.weight') returns 4 because the new alternative lacks a path-segment boundary.
remaining_limitations: No Qwen3-VL-8B or EditScore model weights were available, so full serving/model-load behavior was not verified.
The assigned GPU was AMD gfx950 rather than the report's NVIDIA H100; CUDA backend parity was not tested.
The GPU fixture validates projection shapes and arithmetic only, not model architecture integration or semantic accuracy.
No native source changed and the prepared environment declared no native rebuild target.
